title.narrative: Dansk Røde Kors (DRK) / ICRC indsats i Syrien 2022

description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the ICRC’s response in Syria, seeking 176 million CHF to provide emergency relief, including water and medical care, to people affected by armed conflict, helping maintain contact between separated relatives and fostering respect for IHL and other applicable norms. The ICRC acts as a neutral intermediary for issues of humanitarian concern in Syria.

This allocation of DKK 35 million to ICRC contributes to meeting the objectives of the ICRC’s Syria Appeal for 2022, which in total calls for CHF 176 million in response to humanitarian concerns in conflict-stricken areas of Syria. The ICRC is providing economic security through income support and food production; restoring essential services, such as water and electricity infrastructure; and supporting medical care facilities and physical rehabilitation projects.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.icrc.org/en/resource-centre
